chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou spend a week cramming for final exams. During the history exam, they attempt to cheat, leading to a chaotic scene where Gu Suizhou injures his hip. After the exams, they encounter Lin Sui outside the school gate. Gu Suizhou maintains a facade of intimacy with Shen Feizhi to manipulate the situation, while Shen Feizhi remains cold and detached, correcting Lin Sui's attempt to address him by his former title.

new_characters.name: Lin Sui
new_characters.description: Someone from Gu Suizhou's past who appears at the school gate; he seems to have a history with Gu Suizhou and attempts to address Shen Feizhi with a formal title.
